input_capacitors.rationale: Two in parallel provide margin after DC-bias reduction; one 10µF0603 part is borderline against the TI2.2µF recommended effective input decoupling once bias, tolerance and temperature are included.
input_capacitors.bias_estimate_at_5V: Approximately27% of nominal, from manufacturer typical curve; not a guaranteed production minimum.

regulator: Original LMR51410YFDBVR, bootstrap capacitor, inductor and output network retained; feedback values unchanged.
